message:
As a grandparent, I've learned that storm season can turn a calm household into a chaotic one, especially when the kids start bouncing off the walls. I stumbled upon a resource that would help prepare us for those steamy summer days when the heat can crank up faster than my grandkids can argue over who gets the last cookie. It's all about keeping cool and staying safe — and maybe even finding a few fun indoor activities to distract them! 

What’s your go-to tip for keeping the peace during a stormy spell? 🌩️
